commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: fix: say what an external session is instead of tagging it
commits.body:
I had turned Gervaso's explanation into a one-word pill reading "esterna",
which means nothing on its own and relied on a title attribute — a tooltip
touch devices never show. A label that needs a tooltip has already failed.

It is a sentence again, shortened to fit the header line it now shares with the
path: "Avviata da un altro client". Header is 48px, nothing is cut by the
composer, and the note gives way to the path when there is no room for both.

The assertion that covered it asked for the tag and the tooltip; it now asks
that the marker reads as a sentence and that the tag is gone.
